packageRules.description: Helm charts: one PR per minor step, no automerge, let releases settle first
Major chart bumps wait for approval on the Dependency Dashboard
CNI, storage, secrets, TLS and ingress: every non-patch bump needs Dependency Dashboard approval and goes one minor at a time
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Critical infrastructure chart. Merge one minor step at a time, read the upstream upgrade notes first, and confirm cluster health (`flux get all -A`, all pods Ready, ingress serving) before approving the next step. A Cilium upgrade can orphan existing pod endpoints; plan to restart pods afterwards.

packageRules.description: Grading sandbox: numpy 2.2.6 / PyYAML 6.0.2 ship no cp314/cp315 wheels, so python major and minor bumps are a deliberate change together with those pins

litellm-helm is an OCI chart on docker.litellm.ai, which publishes no release timestamps; with the Renovate 42 default (timestamp-required) every update stays in 'Pending Status Checks' forever. Treat missing timestamps as stable for this chart only, still one minor per PR
llama.cpp trial images are pinned by digest only (plan 0018); there is no tag for Renovate to follow, so skip them instead of warning on every run
